title: Direct electrode-to-electrode regeneration of end-of-life batteries via electrode–electrolyte interphase dissolution
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE01118G, Paper

Kiwon Kim, Chenlu Yang, Sabine M. Gallagher, Shuwen Yue, Vibha Kalra
Selective electrode–electrolyte interphase layer (EEI) dissolution enables direct electrode-to-electrode regeneration of spent Li-ion battery electrodes with up to 95% capacity recovery.
